= A Block Id Containing A Slash

The id of a block becomes the stem of every file extracted from it. `arch/overview` is an
id somebody writes without thinking about it, and joined onto the output directory it
names a subdirectory that does not exist — the extraction then produces nothing at all.

The attribute form is what a document actually gets away with: Asciidoctor rejects
`[[arch/overview]]` and drops `[plantuml#arch/overview]`, but passes `id=` through
untouched, as it does for `[#arch/overview]`.

[plantuml,id="arch/overview"]
----
@startuml
Alice -> Bob : hello
@enduml
----
